summary:
ASTROBASE is an immersive 3D space exploration and flight simulation game developed using Unity 6.3 LTS and the Universal Render Pipeline (URP). The project aims to provide players with an interactive astronaut experience by simulating different stages of space exploration, including spacecraft preparation, rocket launch, deep-space navigation, planetary landing, surface exploration, scientific investigations, and safe crew return
The game features three major expeditions: the Lunar Expedition targeting the Moon's Shackleton Crater, the Red Planet Expedition targeting Mars' Jezero Crater, and the Solar Orbit Expedition focused on solar observation and heliophysics research. The Lunar Expedition is the primary playable mission, while the Mars and Solar Orbit expeditions represent additional mission experiences under development and qualification.
The gameplay incorporates spacecraft flight controls, orbital navigation, thrust management, lunar gravity physics, precision landing challenges, astronaut Extra-Vehicular Activities (EVA), life-support monitoring, and scientific sample collection. Players are evaluated based on mission accuracy, crew safety, fuel conservation, and scientific objectives.
By combining 3D game development, spaceflight simulation, NASA data integration, and interactive scientific exploration, ASTROBASE aims to make space science more engaging and accessible while providing an immersive understanding of the challenges involved in human space exploration.
details:
ASTROBASE: BEYOND EARTH is a 3D space exploration and flight simulation game that allows players to experience the journey of an astronaut. Players can launch spacecraft, travel through space, land on the Moon, explore planetary surfaces, and perform scientific activities such as collecting samples. It also incorporates NASA APIs and scientific datasets to provide authentic space-related information and realistic environments.

The game is developed using Unity. Players begin by selecting a space mission and completing spacecraft preparation and system checks. They then control the spacecraft during launch, navigation, and landing using interactive controls and physics-based mechanics. After landing, players can explore the planetary surface, conduct scientific investigations, and complete mission objectives. NASA APIs and datasets provide additional real-world space information and scientific references.

* Makes space science and astronomy more interactive and engaging.

* Provides practical understanding of spacecraft navigation and space missions.

* Introduces players to planetary environments and scientific exploration.

* Combines gaming with STEM-based learning.

* Creates awareness about NASA missions and human space exploration

We aim to create an immersive and educational space simulation that makes learning about space exploration more accessible and interesting. We hope to help players understand the challenges faced by astronauts, experience realistic space missions, and develop an interest in astronomy, planetary science, and space technology.

| Game Engine | Unity 6.3 LTS |

| Programming Language | C# |

| Rendering Pipeline | Universal Render Pipeline (URP) |

| APIs | NASA APIs |

| Datasets | NASA planetary imagery and scientific datasets |

| Version Control | Git and GitHub |

| Target Platforms | Windows PC and WebGL/WebGPU
